description: T6-1 pin, now an equivalent mutant: the store's connection gets timeout=0, so SQLite stops waiting on a write lock and raises 'database is locked' at once. Since save_session retries SQLITE_BUSY itself (nightly Windows hammer fix), the save still waits out another connection's lock and no test can tell the two apart. It killed this mutant before the retry existed; the retry is what carries the guarantee now, pinned by agent-session-store-busy-not-retried.
